paragraphs: Friend, here's what this passage teaches: one hidden sin is never just one person's private business. Achan took what was set apart, and the Bible says "the anger of the LORD burned against the Israelites" (Joshua 7:1). Nobody at Ai knew about that cloak under the tent floor, but the whole camp felt it. Sin hides real well, and it still costs real things.

Look at what happened when it all fell apart. Joshua fell facedown before the ark and brought his hard questions straight to God (Joshua 7:6-9). And God answered him: "Stand up!" (Joshua 7:10). I think that's a gift, because God told Joshua exactly what was wrong and what to do about it, and when Achan was selected, he said, "It is true… I have sinned against the LORD" (Joshua 7:20).

So here's what I'd carry into the oven today, baker. Take God's commands seriously, because they're for our good. Don't sit on something you know you took, because hiding it only makes the dough burn from the inside. And this isn't the end of the story, since Israel still has a land to enter.
